analyst.summary: ITI Limited's recent 'turnaround' to profitability is not a real operating improvement -- it was driven almost entirely by one-off exceptional gains that were actually larger than the company's entire reported annual profit. Stripped of those one-offs, the core telecom-equipment business shrank roughly 40% over the past year and remains unprofitable. We see this as a case where the market's brief enthusiasm over the headline profit number should not be trusted.
